contract.note: The plain reading (realized aggregate GDP effect through 2024, counting investment) is ordinary and fair. The missing threshold and geography leave the result open to interpretation.

reviews.rationale: The only item covers enterprise spending, which is a narrower scope than the revenue claim. No evidence establishes cumulative spending of about $500B. Neither component is established or refuted on a consistent scope.

contract.note: Testing whether both error types persisted in leading systems by early 2025 is a fair, ordinary reading. It rightly avoids a causal or permanence claim.

evidence.note: Company disclosure reporting a 14.8% PersonQA hallucination rate for o3-mini and nonzero rates for the comparison models. This is an admission of persisting hallucinations.
January 2025 benchmark: frontier models answered under 10% of expert reasoning and knowledge questions. Shows reasoning failures persisted.
Shows reasoning improvements in o3-mini. Improvement is consistent with errors persisting.

reviews.rationale: Dated evaluations from the target period document hallucinations (e1) and reasoning failures (e2) in leading models. Improvements (e3) show there was progress, but not that either error type was eliminated. The support condition is met.
